purpose: Describe the fixed R63 direct TRAIN endpoint and its finite canonical REAL reference before interpreting separately measured distribution gradients.

frozen_population.within_domain_parent_mass: one over original domain N; all original parents and saved order retained
frozen_population.within_region_law: uniform over all original parents in that raw region
frozen_population.regional_objective_mass: unchanged original SOURCE count in region divided by 6593
frozen_population.raw_bins: original un-clipped TRAIN raw-bins; no recomputation from outputs, reassignment, support deletion or Q8 substitution for above

endpoint_and_reference.SOURCE_Y_preADC: First return value of original source_flow_core.endpoint using frozen R63 weights, original input, fixed per-parent innovation, frozen original neural/noise constants and projection.
endpoint_and_reference.SOURCE_Y_canonical: canonical_adc_torch(Y_preADC, False), supplied by registered worker; NumPy two-stage canonical path checked for consistency.
endpoint_and_reference.REAL_reference: canonical_REAL_torch(original REAL TRAIN); full original within-region empirical law, no response-network evaluation for reference.
endpoint_and_reference.REAL_control: Optional separately registered same-treated direct endpoint on all 21047 REAL parents; must be supplied and labeled separately from fixed reference.
endpoint_and_reference.source_charge: q_np of original SOURCE stored float32 values converted to float64; q=sum(v[100:400])-3*sum(v[0:100]), no reporting factor 1000.
endpoint_and_reference.per_parent_noise: Preserve R62 full SOURCE and optional full REAL PCG64 seeds as a reproducible condition. Fixed per-parent noise does not claim bitwise identity with old Heun inference output or independent noise at every repeated training occurrence.

constants_and_directions.U480: subtract each event's first 100 mean and divide by its full-window positive maximum with 0.0025 floor; not unit-charge normalization
constants_and_directions.temporal31: R63 RMS from sqrt(max(power,1e-20)), non-circular ACF lags 1..20, rFFT bins 1..50 grouped in ten five-bin bands; multiply interior bins by 2 and Nyquist by 1; divide frequency power by 10000 and max(power,1e-20)
constants_and_directions.centers_scales: Re-use all R63 frozen old fullview and new temporal REAL TRAIN constants without re-fitting.
constants_and_directions.direction_policy: One pre-fixed bank shared by geometry and gradient reference; no redraw by scope or replicate. This diagnostic bank is distinct from the original training direction stream that redrew each update.

matched_REAL_floor_design.sample_N_each_side_each_scope: exact original SOURCE count in the same scope
matched_REAL_floor_design.A_and_B: Independent with-replacement uniform draws from canonical REAL parents in that same raw region; all scope draws from all original REAL parents.
matched_REAL_floor_design.comparison: REAL_A vs REAL_B; SOURCE remains compared with the entire canonical REAL scope, not either draw
matched_REAL_floor_design.duplicates: retained as occurrences with mass 1/N; no unique-row replacement or duplicate merging
matched_REAL_floor_design.supplied_indices: global REAL row indices (32, SOURCE scope N), frozen and saved by the root worker before geometry computation
matched_REAL_floor_design.generation_template: Two PCG64 generators A/B. For each fixed scope in order, choose original sorted global REAL region rows ri; emit ri[rng.integers(0,len(ri),size=(32,SOURCE_scope_N),dtype=int64)] in C order.

all_scopes_full_reference: Every old fullview coordinate W1 vector, mean, RMS and maximum after original regional standardization; all 64 fixed projection W1 values and their mean.
All 31 temporal coordinate W1 values and all 64 fixed temporal projection W1 values, with marginal/sliced half sum.
The same coordinate W1 vectors without regional standardization, including full-population physical V480 residuals.
full_window, coordinate_RMS, temporal_joint by scope; all ten unmodified SOURCE masses and weighted regional contributions; all-scope pooled standardized statistic labeled separately.
Optional same-treated REAL full-reference residuals, kept separate from SOURCE and from reference.

SOURCE original/direct-preADC/canonical and REAL raw/canonical q count, min, 10/50/90-percentile, max, mean, SD; source-original to raw/canonical REAL and source-canonical to canonical REAL empirical q W1.
Per-parent and scope summaries of direct preADC q error, generated ADC q change, total canonical q error and raw-to-canonical REAL q change.
all_scopes_32_REAL_pairs: All coordinate/projection W1 arrays and all three component values for every A/B replicate.
Raw and canonical REAL q W1 for every A/B replicate; no single selected replicate.
Original A/B global indices and unique-parent counts; all repeated occurrences retained.
All SOURCE-vs-complete-REAL minus REAL-pair component values; descriptive summary only, no new pass/fail scientific threshold.
each_original_region_charge_mean_bound: Dout=abs(mean q(source_canonical)-mean q(canonical_REAL)) and Dsrc=abs(mean original q_source-mean q(canonical_REAL)), including signed gaps.
epsq=mean abs(q(source_canonical)-original q_source), measured on actual shared endpoint; preADC and ADC changes reported separately.
Actual represented V480 zbar reconstructed as mu+scale*zbar; Erep=sum abs(a)*mean absolute reconstruction residual across both laws, evaluated nominally in float64.
Source-charge versions substitute [Dsrc-epsq-Erep]+; report both forms, observed coordinate mean/RMS and their ratios.
Weighted V480 bound sum m_source*(LBmean/8+LBRMS/4), all regional contributions and ratio to observed full_window+coordinate_RMS; zero denominator yields null.

numerical_semantics.standardized_represented_coordinates: float32 after float64 subtraction and division using frozen center/scale
numerical_semantics.projected_represented_coordinates: float32 matrix product using supplied float32 directions
numerical_semantics.empirical_W1: R62 quantile-partition integral for unequal uniform empirical laws, nominal float64 sorting/subtraction/reduction; bounded column scratch space
numerical_semantics.representation_error: Reconstruct actual zbar to voltage, so discrepancy is not limited to an ideal final cast error; reconstruction and reduction themselves remain un-enclosed float64 arithmetic.
numerical_semantics.bound_independence: Bounds are output-specific diagnostics. No valid uniform bound across all neural outputs or all permitted ADC errors is asserted.

root_registration_fields_still_required: Actual work directory, unique scientific job, host/resource guard and source/helper hashes; this preparation directory is not an execution registration.
Frozen R63 model tensor hash and checkpoint identity; direct endpoint worker implementation hash.
Legal TRAIN archive, SOURCE and REAL parent identities/order, original raw-bin and charge binding; all constants archives and arrays by name/hash.
Actual accepted direction and A/B seeds, RNG state/consumption order, supplied noise/direction/index hashes and shared-reference compatibility with the gradient module.
Whether all-REAL same-treated direct endpoint control is included, with its separately recorded model row count.
Scientific output file names, checksum manifest and completion receipt fields; original source population/weights and A-F preserved.
stop_and_close: Input/hash/parent/order/shape/raw-bin/constant/direction/canonical-path mismatch stops the worker; no row deletion or replacement, new fit, support change or non-TRAIN read to repair a result.

Any nonfinite statistic, resource failure, or failed nominal charge inequality check stops implementation acceptance. Save failure evidence without widening the numerical tolerance after observing scientific results.

Complete all ten regions, full population and all 32 predetermined REAL pairs; no favorable-region/replicate selection, seed search, extra directions, altered scales or extended sampling after a result.

Finish this fixed descriptive analysis. It does not authorize training, checkpoint selection, feature addition, larger training batches, source mass changes, changed A-F or R60 conclusions, or D/E execution.
